Container.Name: WhatToPlay
Container.Overview:
A video-game backlog manager. Games are grouped into franchises and kept in play order, and "What to play next" suggests the next game of a random franchise.
Requires a MariaDB (or MySQL) server with a database and a user for WhatToPlay. Set Network Type to the network your MariaDB container is on, so DB_HOST can be its container name.
On first start the app creates its tables, then offers to import a backup.
Container.Requires: An existing MariaDB / MySQL server, with a database and a user created for WhatToPlay (see the project page for the SQL, which can be run in Adminer).

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port the app is reached on, e.g. http://your-server:8095

Config.Name: DB_HOST
Config.Description: Database server: the MariaDB container's name when both are on the same custom network (choose it in Network Type above), otherwise the server's IP address

Config.Name: DB_NAME
Config.Description: Name of the database created for WhatToPlay

Config.Name: Backups
Config.Description: Folder for the daily backup files (the same files as the Export button; restore one with Import)

Config.Name: BACKUP_KEEP
Config.Description: Number of daily backup files to keep

Config.Name: BACKUP_TIME
Config.Description: Time of the daily backup (HH:MM, server time)

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id the app runs as (owner of the backup files)

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id the app runs as
